profile.headline: Backend-focused Full-Stack & Cloud Engineer | Ex-Microsoft | Azure, C#, Microservices | Distributed Systems
profile.summary:
Backend-focused full-stack engineer with 4+ years of experience at Microsoft, part of the TopTal network. 

I specialize in backend and cloud engineering using technologies such as C#, Azure, and microservices architectures, developing scalable systems that support enterprise workflows and large-scale content processing. At Microsoft, I worked on a proprietary localization platform, building distributed services, and improving processing throughput through infrastructure and pipeline improvements.

My experience spans backend development, cloud infrastructure, and DevOps, including CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and scalable service design.  

Prior to Microsoft, I gained industry experience through engineering roles and internships at organizations such as Raytheon Technologies, Verizon Communications, and ABB.  

After taking a planned sabbatical in 2025 to travel and gain new perspectives across Europe, Southeast Asia, and Latin America, I’m excited to return to engineering.  

Currently open to full-stack, backend, cloud, and platform engineering opportunities, both remote and on-site.

positions.title: Gap year
positions.description:
After 4+ years as a Software Engineer at Microsoft, I took an intentional sabbatical year to focus on personal growth and global travel. During this time I walked the Camino de Santiago across Portugal and Spain, earned my PADI Open Water Diver Certification in Thailand, worked as a barista in Indonesia, and traveled across Southeast Asia, Europe, and Latin America. The experience allowed me to immerse myself in different cultures, including events such as Las Fallas in Valencia and Chinese New Year celebrations in Asia. I’m now returning to engineering with renewed focus and energy. 

Recap Instagram Post: https://www.instagram.com/p/DSyEB-1Dien/?img_index=1

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
⁠•⁠ Delivered microservices-based capabilities in Azure (C#, Functions, MVC) for a proprietary content localization platform, building scalable file-processing pipelines and handoff/handback services to support enterprise localization workflows.

•⁠  ⁠Built data-ingestion services capable of processing 25MB+ artifacts, expanding platform capacity and enabling larger software and content localization projects across the pipeline.

•⁠  ⁠Identified and resolved a critical UI performance bottleneck affecting both software and content localization platforms, reducing page load times from ~2 minutes to milliseconds and significantly improving project management workflow efficiency.

•⁠  ⁠Designed and implemented Azure File Share caching, reducing ingestion workload processing time by 4× and increasing throughput for localization operations.

•⁠  ⁠Owned and maintained CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps across development, staging, and production environments for both localization platforms; became the team’s secondary infrastructure expert supporting deployment reliability.

•⁠  ⁠Authored infrastructure-as-code documentation and internal training for Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates, enabling team self-service and reducing reliance on infrastructure specialists by ~30% per sprint.
positions.insights: Skills: DevOps · Microsoft Azure · C# · Full-Stack Development · .NET Framework

positions.title: Teacher Assistant
positions.description: Provided office hours related to REST APIs and SQL topics while also grading quizzes and full stack web projects.

positions.title: Software Engineering/Process Engineering COOP
positions.description: Devised and implemented a DevOps tool chain to support further development endeavors, decreasing development to production time by 23%. Designed and deployed an ASP.net MVC application for the HR department which reduces absence report generation time by 83%

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Collaborated in a 3-member team in developing a web app in Vue.js that aids Test Engineers by shortening Test Error Reports generation time by 60%

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Contributed in a 6-member team in analyzing log data from a proprietary web app with ELK Stack technologies. Implemented a custom plugin for Kibana in Angular.js to add more data visualizations and a custom dashboard.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Enabled approximately $1.6M annually in IT savings by reducing web application development time by 78% by collaborating in a seven member team to develop a front-end code generator tool.
